description: This PHP class 'WorkflowStateMachineDecorator' acts as a decorator for the 'WorkflowStateMachine' entity, providing methods to access and manipulate workflow state machine data, specifically roles to notify.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachineDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for WorkflowStateMachine entity, providing additional or simplified access to its data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a WorkflowStateMachine object.

methods.name: getWorkflowStateMachine
methods.description: Protected method to access the wrapped WorkflowStateMachine object.

methods.name: getRolesToNotify
methods.description: Returns an array of roles to notify, parsed from a comma-separated string, or null if none.
